why_use_section.title: Why We Engineer with MongoDB
why_use_section.subtitle: MongoDB provides the architectural flexibility needed for modern applications with evolving data requirements.
paragraphs: MongoDB’s document model (BSON) allows for nested structures and flexible schemas, eliminating the friction of complex SQL joins. We choose it for projects where rapid prototyping and the ability to store polymorphic data are critical for business agility.
With built-in replication and horizontal sharding, MongoDB ensures your application remains highly available and performant even as your data grows into the terabyte range and beyond.
